estimators.ratio: N/S, N64/S and N64/N: the ratio of two arms' means of one user-mode counter over the measured phase, with a two-sample BCa 95% interval over the run's rounds
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.diagnostic: phase counters on the shapes Expanse loses, outside METHODOLOGY.md's pre-registration
provenance.privilege: sudo -n on each per-process perf stat + phase_probe command
